jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
Working as part of the Software Development team the post holder will be a software development specialist, with experience of developing and implementing technical software solutions to meet business requirements and support the organisation in the achievement of its strategic objectives. The software development team develop bespoke applications to support EEC where no ‘off the shelf’ solutions exist.
  
  
The post holder will ensure that projects produce the required deliverables within the defined quality, time and cost constraints and facilitate full realisation of benefits defined in the associated business cases which they may help develop. This will be achieved by adherence to relevant software development methodology and best practice within the profession.
  
  
The post holder will establish productive working relationships with colleagues within the organisation at all to facilitate the successful delivery of software solutions. The Senior Software Developer will be proficient with modern software development methodologies. They will also be proficient with version control.
  
  
In addition to software development the post holder is also expected to provide support for changes and development for the suite of applications delivered by the development team as and when appropriate.
  
  
Please note; Interviews will be Face-2-Face.
  
  
"(Should we receive a high number of applications we reserve the right to close this vacancy at any point after 09/10/2026)"
  
  
Expertise and a proven track record in system design, application architecture, programming, procedural, declarative or structured querying programming language.
  
  
Technical knowledge of MS SQL relational databases, database design and the Structured Query Language.
  
  
Proven experience using Visual Studio to write software code and produce elegant, robust and maintainable software applications.
  
  
Proven experience using current C# ASP.NET versions 8 and above
  
  
A command of the principles of good software design using the principles of SOLID and object-oriented programming.
  
  
Practical experience using source control systems (i.e. Git).
  
  
Rated ‘Outstanding’ by the Care Quality Commission, we are proud to provide high quality innovative services across most of the east of England that enable people to receive care closer to home and live healthier lives.
  
  
There’s one reason why our services are outstanding – and that’s our amazing staff who, for the seventh year running, rated us incredibly highly in the national staff survey.
  
  
If you share our passion for innovative and high-quality care delivery, then please submit your application and join us on our exciting journey as a leading-edge specialist community provider. All are welcome to apply and our promise to you is a culture which prioritises staff engagement and development.
  
  
Please be aware that East of England Community Health and Care NHS Trust will never ask applicants to pay fees at any stage of the recruitment process, including job applications, sponsorship arrangements, or employment offers. All recruitment communications and job applications should only be made through our official careers website and published contact details.
  
  
If you receive a suspicious job offer or recruitment-related communication, do not make any payments, share personal information, or provide identity documents. We encourage you to report the matter to your local police or relevant law enforcement agency. Any concerns relating to potential recruitment fraud should also be reported to our Local Counter Fraud Specialist (LCFS) as soon as possible.
  
  
**Duties/Responsibilities:****The post holder must be able to demonstrate:**  
Expertise and a proven track record in system design, application architecture, programming, procedural, declarative or structured querying programming language.
  
  
Technical knowledge of MS SQL relational databases, database design and the Structured Query Language.
  
  
Proven experience using Visual Studio to write software code and produce elegant, robust and maintainable software applications.
  
  
Proven experience using current C# ASP.NET versions 8 and above
  
  
A command of the principles of good software design using the principles of SOLID and object-oriented programming.
  
  
Practical experience using source control systems (i.e. Git).
  
  
Undertake responsibility for own code and review others code to ensure quality and adherence to our software standards.
  
  
Engage and liaise with end users and project stakeholders (project managers/BAs) to identify system and information requirements.
  
  
Discuss progress and notify senior staff of impediments during regular team meetings.
  
  
Discuss ideas with colleagues and review tasks and priorities in collaboration with other team members and senior staff.
  
  
Contribute ideas on how the team can become more effective.
  
  
Actively listen to the advice and guidance of colleagues and tune behaviour accordingly – for example listen to suggestions from colleagues during pair programming sessions and code reviews.
  
  
Speak confidently to groups of users or peers; Demonstrating ideas, concepts and software and answering questions.
  
  
Discuss ideas with their line manager on ways to improve their performance and advance personal development - at personal development reviews, for example.
  
  
Continual upgrading of skills to reflect rapid changes in technology. This is achieved through formal training; informal skills transfer and self-tuition.
  
  
Influence and participate in defining standards for development through research and implementation of new technologies and solutions.
  
  
Plan own workload and activities over short to medium periods to meet project deadlines and provide user support, this often involves multiple complex projects and support incidents.
  
  
Prioritise own workload to resolve conflicts between project and support tasks which involves re-planning; escalating to the Software Development Manager when required.
  
  
Collaborate with key stakeholders to identify service needs and to enable the realisation of business value.
  
  
Able to proactively identify opportunities to improve a service for stakeholders.
  
The post holder must be familiar with Windows PC and server operating systems.
  
**The post holder shall be expected to:** -
  
  
Follow good development practice by adhering to the organisation’s conventions for checking software code into source control systems.
  
  
Contribute to the production of suitable quality control records (such as problem or change records) for application and system software changes.
  
  
Knowledge share, support and mentor team members in ensuring that software applications have full patch and version control in place and that the organisation has a comprehensive record of all these amendments.
  
  
Implement system software upgrades as and when required.
  
  
Communication
  
  
Required to communicate with staff, patients and stakeholders at all levels from different disciplines.
  
  
Represent the department (at the request of the Software Development Manager) internally and externally at multi-disciplinary working groups / meetings and co-ordinate information responses.
  
  
Will be required to communicate highly complex technical advice in a non-technical way so the end user can understand.
  
  
Receive and interpret highly complex information from a variety of sources.
  
  
Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.
  
  
Human Resources
  
  
To participate in the appraisal process for EEC NHS Trust and take responsibility for working with line manager to identify an appropriate personal development plan.
  
  
To knowledge share and support other colleagues/teams or services going through change.
  
  
To maintain own professional development and requirement to take part in appraisal and Knowledge and Skills Framework (KSF) process.
  
  
Responsibility for Financial & Physical Resources
  
  
Responsible for the provision of technical solutions in the delivery and maintenance of a trust wide web solutions and for IT assets.
  
  
Research & Development Activity
  
  
Required to undertake R&D activity on a regular basis, once a month or more.
  
  
R&D activity is a major job requirement, at least 20% of the working
  
  
Clinical and Practice Governance
  
  
Observe and maintain strict confidentiality with regards to any patient/family/staff/records and information in line with the requirements of the Data Protection Act.
  
  
Any data that is taken/shared as part of a phone call or transported, faxed or transferred electronically must be undertaken with regard to EEC Information Governance and Information Security policies.
  
  
The post holder must adhere to EEC risk assessment and risk management processes
  
  
The post holder must adhere to infection control policies and procedures
  
  
Undertake mandatory training and any other training relevant to the role as required by EEC .
  
  
The post holder must participate in clinical and other audits as required.
  
  
The post holder is required to participate in relevant emergency preparedness process for their team.
  
  
**Working conditions:**  
Flexibility and resilience is required due to working in a dynamic and fast paced team with competing priorities.
  
  
The post holder will be expected to be able to meet the flexible working requirements of the role. Ability to work remotely or from hot desk facilities at different sites is essential.
  
  
General
  
The post holder must at all times carry out his/her duties with regard to East of England Community Health and Care NHS Trust Equal Opportunities Policy.
  
  
To be aware of the responsibilities of all employees to maintain a safe and healthy environment for patients, visitors and staff.
  
  
All post holders must adhere to the code of conduct on confidentiality and be aware of and adhere to all EEC policies and procedures.
  
  
This job description is intended only as a guide to the range of duties involved. The post holder will need to be flexible and adaptable in order to respond to other duties that may be required from time to time and the changes and developments within EEC.

jobs.title: Mainframe software engineer (senior)
jobs.description:
Would you like to join the Collateral & Impairment team in Reporting Solutions responsible for several business-critical data hubs of collateral and credit deterioration data for business solutions and reporting processes? Do you want to participate in the data tech transformation in BEC, soon to be Nykredit Financial Technologies?

BEC is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Reporting Solutions domain. The position will be based at our friendly office in Roskilde or Warsaw.

Reporting Solutions plays a vital role in ensuring compliance of BEC’s member banks by managing a portfolio of 40+ business solutions within the business areas of Credit Risk and Finance Solutions, including several business-critical data hubs that support banks' business processes, internal reporting, and obligations in regulatory reporting.

You will join the Collateral & Impairment team with responsibility for both maintenance and development of a portfolio of business solutions that ensure accurate, reliable, and traceable data on assets, collateral, impairment, and write-off used in business-critical credit risk processes as well as regulatory reporting.

You will join a high‑performing, cross‑functional team, combining solid business knowledge with strong software engineering practices. The team works with Mainframe, Netezza, and Databricks platforms and does coding in COBOL, SQL, and Java, and apply BI tools such as PowerCenter and SAP Business Objects. The team is currently situated in Herning but will transition and consolidate in Roskilde and Warsaw by end of 2027.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of BEC’s data tech transformation, using modern, Cloud-based technologies and event‑driven architectures to build scalable data products to substitute for current business solutions. This will give banks easier access to trusted, consistent data, whether for self-service analytics, reporting, regulatory requirements, or operational processes.

**Primary tasks and responsibilities include:**

* Manage incidents and problems effectively in close collaboration with colleagues and clients.
* Maintain and develop systems, data, and platforms within the business area of Credit Risk.
* Ensure stable operations through maintenance, housekeeping, and quality improvements.
* Design end-to-end data processing flows for collateral, impairment, and regulatory data.
* Develop high-quality business solutions based on business requirements in close cooperation with key stakeholders internally in BEC and clients.
* Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, Software Engineers, and Architects in Reporting Solutions to ensure high-quality, reliable, and well‑governed data foundations.
* Participate in the data tech transformation in BEC towards a modern data platform using Databricks.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the development process and client engagement.

**To succeed you will have:**

* A relevant Master degree.
* 5y+ work experience as Software Engineer from Banking or financial IT.
* Preferably, with work experience as a team architect.
* Preferably, work experience from the banking sector in Denmark.
* Extensive knowledge of collateral, impairment, and regulatory data.
* Extensive work experience with Mainframe, DB2, JCL, COBOL, and I\*Net.
* Preferably, programming skills in SQL, Python, and Java.
* Preferably, experience with PowerCenter workflow development.
* Experience with Git, Jira, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience of working in agile setups like Scrum or SAFe.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.
* Fluency in English, written and spoken.
* Danish is an advantage.

As a person, you are ambitious, goal oriented, and persistent. You have a curious and analytical mindset. You are a team player who is proactive and takes responsibility. You are service minded towards both clients and colleagues.

**Be your best self with BEC's benefits!**

We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

* Professional development budget
* Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen
* Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, salsa dancing etc.
* Flexible starting time
* Health insurance
* Referral bonus

**What does the recruitment process look like?**

* Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

* Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match

* Meet our technical expert: Learn more about the job, BEC Poland, and tell us more about your skills and experience.

* Meet your future manager

* Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC!

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent attraction partner, Anna Barcińska at Anna.Barcinska@BEC.dk.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer - Integration Platform
jobs.description:
Do you want to shape how development teams across Sandvik build and operate integrations at scale? Join us in creating the platform capabilities, automation and templates that enable secure self-service delivery across the organization.

Some of the things you'll do:

* Build reusable capabilities that reduce manual work and enable independence.
* Influence the developer experience across APIs, integrations a nd event-driven solutions.
Collaborate closely with architects, product specialists, and development teams.  

**Your mission**

In this position, you focus on building the tools, templates, and automation that enable development teams to create and operate integrations independently. Experience with end-to-end integration delivery is great to have, although this work centers on reusable platform capabilities rather than individual integrations. Working from vendor-agnostic principles, you turn standards and architectural direction into practical platform capabilities that perform reliably in production. You’re part of the PA Engineering Platforms Integration team and report to the Competence Manager.

Job responsibilities:

* Build and maintain our self-service integration builder using reusable platform components, templates and shared services for APIs, integrations and event-driven solutions built on top of Azure Integration Services.
* Develop CI/CD pipelines, automation services and utilities that support platform delivery and operations.
* Embed security, logging, reliability, quality and compliance controls into pipelines and templates.
* Translate architecture and technical standards into consistent, production-ready implementation patterns.
* Onboard and support development teams using the platform, improving its capabilities based on their feedback.
Troubleshoot live integrations and take ownership of platform components in production.  

**Location**

This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken.

**Your profile**

You’re an experienced engineer with a strong software development foundation and exposure to platform engineering, DevOps and enterprise integration environments. Translating architectural direction and technical standards into reusable solutions comes naturally to you, and you enjoy creating capabilities that other development teams can adopt with confidence.

Your background also includes:

* Hands-on production experience with Azure Integration Services, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management (APIM), and Service Bus or Event Grid.
* Strong programming skills in C# or Python, combined with the ability to write and troubleshoot Bash and/or PowerShell scripts.
* Experience with integration patterns, including APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture, and API gateways or enterprise integration platforms.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD, deployment automation, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep or similar), and cloud-native environments.
Experience working with distributed systems and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.  

Additionally, experience with front-end technologies such as React or Angular, as well as relational and NoSQL databases, is considered an advantage.

With a developer-first mindset, you balance high technical standards with pragmatic decisions that move work forward. You communicate complex topics clearly, collaborate constructively, and take ownership of what you build, while continuously improving the experience for teams using the platform.

**Our culture**

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub , LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer - Integration Delivery
jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to combine hands-on software engineering with end-to-end ownership to build APIs and integrations that support business-critical operations while contributing to a reusable integration platform. Welcome to Sandvik Group IT!

Some of the things you'll do here:

* Build and own integrations from initial design through deployment and production support.
* Work with modern engineering practices covering APIs, automation, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.
Turn delivery experience into reusable components, templates and technical improvements.  

**Your mission**

In this role, you design, develop and maintain custom integrations and APIs for business areas and projects built natively on Azure Integration Services. Your work combines hands-on engineering with production responsibility, and you ensure that each delivery follows standardized patterns for security, logging, monitoring, resilience and error handling. You’re part of the PA Engineering Platforms Integration team and report to the Competence Manager.

Job responsibilities:

* Design and develop production-ready APIs and integrations using synchronous, asynchronous and event-driven patterns with Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Event Grid and Azure API Management.
* Build integration logic, APIs and automation components in C# or Python, supported by Bash or PowerShell scripting.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code for repeatable, automated deployments.
* Implement technical guardrails for authentication, authorization, secrets, certificates, networking, logging, monitoring and policy validation.
* Own live integrations in production, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident resolution and performance improvements.
Convert delivery learnings into reusable templates, platform components, runbooks, post-mortems and clear technical documentation.  

**Location**

This position is based at the World Trade Center in Stockholm or Mossvägen in Sandviken.

**Your profile**

You’re an experienced integration engineer with a strong background in building and operating enterprise integrations. Combining software engineering with integration expertise, you understand how APIs, cloud services, automation and operations come together to create secure, reliable and maintainable solutions.

Your background also includes:

* Hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Event Grid and Azure API Management. You’ve designed resilient integrations with effective retry, error-handling and monitoring approaches and understand the engineering practices required to operate integrations in production.
* Strong programming skills in C# or Python, alongside experience using Bash or PowerShell for deployment and operational automation.
* Practical knowledge of REST APIs, messaging, asynchronous communication, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated deployments and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep or similar technologies.
Knowledge of cloud platforms, containerization, observability, resilience, security controls, and production support.  

Methodical and pragmatic in your approach, you stay composed when solving incidents and complex technical challenges. You take ownership, listen closely to business needs, and make sound decisions that balance delivery speed with long-term maintainability. Collaboration comes naturally, and you enjoy sharing knowledge with architects, platform engineers, product stakeholders, and other delivery teams.

**Our culture**

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative, and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort, so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential.
